changelog: v3.1 Nov 12 ~4:40 PM ET: N01/N02/N11 now use the Desecrate copy (one Frostbearer is enough). N13 has the exact 3.30-tree ore path (4 + 13 points). Zizaran baseline added to launch_plan §1.1c.

v3 Nov 12 ~4:15 PM ET: Spectre Necro 1A. Added N01-N13 (Frostbearer capture, Verisium protocol, spectre levels, Necro uniques, no-Frostbearer fallback, Ore atlas node) and H05 (Boneshatter fallback). Totem triggers D04, D07, D09, H02, H03 set active:false (kept for history). Occultist triggers kept as 1B.
v2 Nov 12 11:40 AM ET: Occultist plan.
notes: priority: 1 = act immediately, 2 = act at next session start, 3 = consider/log. confidence: '3.30-confirmed' | '3.29-assumed' | 'user-rule' | 'estimate' | 'unverified'. Conditions reference tracker state fields: char.level, char.tier_band, char.res_fire/cold/light/chaos, char.pool (life+ES), char.pob_ehp, char.phys_max_hit, char.build, stash.items, session.elapsed_min, session.near_deaths_30m. Triggers with active:false are kept for history and ignored by the tracker.

triggers.condition: always
triggers.action: On ED Occultist: equip at the self-cast swap. On the Necro: stash it as the 1B Occultist trigger; roll ED/Contagion/Blight Occultist if the Necro is struggling or as char #2 (your test: Cane + Militant Faith was a huge spike).

triggers.condition: stash has high armour/evasion rare shield
triggers.action: Consider Shield Crush Slayer as char #2; else stash and watch for a shield base.

triggers.condition: main char tier_band >= T6 gate met OR main char dead
triggers.action: Same Necromancer ascendancy: if the main passes the T6 gate, roll PRAW as char #2 (or respec if spectres stall); else stash it. Head-to-head: 216k EHP / 17.8M army at L92 PoB.

triggers.condition: always
triggers.action: Roll Storm Burst Hierophant (1B starter; Inquisitor only for self-cast).
triggers.inactive_reason: Totems dropped after your Nov 12 test (Storm Burst felt slow/clunky).

triggers.condition: always
triggers.action: Test a Cyclone Slayer right away (your test: Cyclone with a nice weapon felt great). Do not plan a farm until poedb confirms the drop source.
triggers.source: Drop source unconfirmed as of Nov 11; the item is shown in GGG/third-party previews

triggers.condition: pdps>=750
triggers.action: Cyclone Slayer candidate (better with Replica Stampede). Only pivot with the weapon in hand.

triggers.condition: stash has 6L bow OR rare Artillery Quiver OR >=3 Essence of Dread
triggers.action: Roll EA Ballista Champion (near-hard). If none of those: strong consideration, stash it.
triggers.inactive_reason: EA dropped after your Nov 12 test; Porcupine farm also gone with Gardens.

triggers.condition: char.build=='ED Occultist'
triggers.action: Equip on the Occultist (Blight from 41); on the Necro: stash for 1B.

triggers.condition: rare with life/res
triggers.action: Stash for EA Champion; strengthens D07.

triggers.condition: always
triggers.action: Never spend on random whites. Save for a chosen unique base (much rarer but much higher unique chance in 3.30).

triggers.item: Fugitive Boots / Apothecary's Gloves / Two-Toned Boots (tier-gated bases)
triggers.condition: tiered magic/rare
triggers.action: Fugitive Boots (chaos res) matter for the Necro too; Apothecary's (DoT multi) only for the 1B Occultist; Two-Toned for double res.

triggers.condition: 2 or 3 rares with the same name
triggers.action: Vendor: 2 = Chaos Orb, 3 = Exalted Orb.

triggers.condition: count of Frostbearers raised; char.build=='Spectre Necromancer'
triggers.action: FIRST: Desecrate with the Offerings off and Spell Echo off Raise Spectre, then raise copies to your cap. Desecrate spawns corpses of your most recently raised spectres, so ONE Frostbearer is enough. Keep Frostbearers as the most recent raises (raise utility spectres before them). 1-2: mixed setup (Absolution + Frostbearers). 3+ at Raise Spectre effective level 22+: swap to the Frostbearer 6L (Spell Echo, Greater Volley, Minion Damage, Controlled Destruction, Hypothermia) and do Ziz's 8-12 point respec.
triggers.source: Desecrate gem text (poedb); Zizaran x Helm Breaker 3.30 guide; Ghazzy 3.29 guide; launch_plan.md §0.5

triggers.condition: Verisium ore deposit in the map
triggers.action: Unsocket the Bone Offering/Desecrate trigger, channel FULLY (3.30 XP buff), and check the wave element: only cold (frost/ice) waves can hold Frostbearers. Raise ONE before the encounter ends (corpses vanish when cleared), then Desecrate-copy the rest. Never with Fates or Deified active.
triggers.source: 3.30.0 notes (Verisium still in game); r/PathOfExileSSF 3.29 reports

triggers.condition: Raise Spectre effective level reaches 21 / 22 / 25
triggers.action: 21: corrupt a spare (keep one clean). 22: meets the T6/T11 spectre gate (PoB: 158k per Frostbearer). 25: 3 spectres (206k each, minion life 34k). Path to 25: gem 21 + wand +1 + shield +1 + helmet +2 (or Bones of Ullr +1).

triggers.condition: always
triggers.action: Equip on the Necro (+1 Raise Spectre level and +1 spectre per Ghazzy). Chance-orb target: Silk Slippers.

triggers.item: Minion level gear (+1/+2 minion wand, shield or helmet)
triggers.condition: +1 or +2 to Level of all Minion Skill Gems AND keeps res capped
triggers.action: Equip: each +1 to Raise Spectre ≈ +15-30% spectre DPS and much more minion life. Wand: leave an open suffix for the Refinery trigger craft.

triggers.condition: res can be covered elsewhere
triggers.action: Equip on the Necro (amulet in every Ghazzy budget). Chance target: Citrine Amulet.

triggers.condition: res can be covered elsewhere (abyss jewels)
triggers.action: Equip with Ghastly Eye jewels. Stygian Vise is now a high-tier core drop in 3.30 (chance target).
triggers.source: Ghazzy 3.29; 3.30 notes: Stygian Vise core drop pool

triggers.condition: spectre variant (Raise Spectre max doubled)
triggers.action: HARD upgrade: doubles max spectres; drop zombies/golems. Other variants: stash.
triggers.source: Ghazzy medium budget; 3.30 notes only add a tooltip popup

triggers.condition: always
triggers.action: 3.30 buff: +2-3 minion gem levels, 80-100% minion damage, can roll +10-15% minion dmg per spectre / 3-5% speed per SRS. Bridge weapon while Frostbearers are missing; Divine old copies to new values.

triggers.item: Ghastly Eye Jewel / Bone Ring / Bone Helmet (minion bases)
triggers.condition: minion life/damage + res
triggers.action: Keep. Bone Helmet is tier-gated in 3.30 but now 20-30% minion damage. Bone Rings help spectre survival late (JayOE).

triggers.condition: at each checkpoint M1-M13, compare session.elapsed_min to the 6h / 7h / 8h columns
triggers.action: Over 7h pace: tighten overhead (stops ≤ 12 min, rules C1-C4). Never skip safety gates. Cruel lab stays right before A10 Kitava.

triggers.condition: entering the fight
triggers.action: Check ele res can absorb -30 (A5) / -60 total (A10); re-cap at the next town before continuing.
triggers.source: Campaign mechanic, unchanged in the 3.30 notes

triggers.condition: clock >= 00:00 ET OR session.near_deaths_30m >= 2 OR a gate can't be met without farming
triggers.action: Stash insurance items, log stats, log off.

triggers.condition: char.level >= 68
triggers.action: Buy/reroll contracts with gold; Normal contracts cost Alchemy.
triggers.source: 3.30.0 notes: Heist (level-68 meaning char level is unverified)

triggers.condition: res 75 AND res_chaos>=0 AND pool>=3200 (Necro: life>=3000)
triggers.action: Allow white maps, Fate cap 1. Otherwise stay in campaign/lower maps and fix gear.
triggers.source: Occultist: Ziz Slinger L72; Necro: launch_plan.md §4.2

triggers.condition: ele 75 + ~10 overcap AND chaos>=30 AND pool>=4500 (Necro 4000) AND phys_max_hit>=6000
triggers.action: Allow yellow maps, Fate cap 2.

triggers.condition: chaos>=60 AND pool>=6000 (Necro 5000) AND pob_ehp>=60000 (Necro 51000) AND block>=50
triggers.action: Allow red maps, Fate cap 3 on bosses already killed on this char.

triggers.condition: chaos>=75 AND pool>=7000 (Necro 5500) AND pob_ehp>=100000 (Necro 51000) AND phys_max_hit>=10000
triggers.action: Allow Legion Threads (Timeless Jewel farming) and 3-Fate red bosses.
triggers.source: Your T15-for-Legion rule; 115k bar; Ziz Early Cane L93 = 113k EHP

triggers.condition: char.build in [Spectre Necromancer, PRAW Necromancer]
triggers.action: Use the relaxed ~51k PoB EHP bar at T11/T15 instead of 60k/100k (stretch 100k+: Ghazzy low budget = 183k). Necro pool gates 3.0k/4.0k/5.0k/5.5k; block >= 50% with Bone Offering at T11. Chaos gates unchanged.

triggers.condition: in campaign
triggers.action: 0 Fates; skip coven detours.
triggers.source: 3.30 confirms Fates make bosses harder; time/risk call

triggers.condition: boss not yet killed on this char
triggers.action: Max 1 Fate (0 if it's a new 3.30 boss).

triggers.condition: plain pinnacle not yet killed on this char OR pob_ehp<115000
triggers.action: Do not invoke.
triggers.source: 3.30 FAQ: Grim-Fated pinnacles guarantee Viscera; deadlier

triggers.condition: tier_band < T11
triggers.action: Never combine with Fates (+25% dmg, +25% speed, +100% toughness on bosses).

triggers.condition: first time seeing a Fate
triggers.action: Log its text in the tracker; treat ground degen / on-death explosion Fates as 1-Fate-only until seen.
triggers.source: Full ordinary Fate list not public as of Nov 12

triggers.condition: flasks empty OR pool < 30%
triggers.action: Drop one tier band; do a gear audit (W7). A second one within 30 min ends the session (S03).

triggers.condition: character died
triggers.action: If the reroll stash has a hard-trigger item, roll that build (Cane → Occultist, AWoRA → PRAW, Sword of Ages/750 staff → Cyclone). Else re-roll Spectre Necro (spectres must be re-captured). Nothing working → Boneshatter fallback.

triggers.item: poedb drop source for a trigger item
triggers.condition: poedb updates source for Sword of Ages / AWoRA / Cane / Dark Monarch / Femurs / Bones of Ullr
triggers.action: Add a target farm to the plan if it's farmable at your tier band.

triggers.condition: patch note mentions Raise Spectre/Absolution/SRS/Necromancer/minions/Verisium (or ED/Contagion/Occultist for 1B)
triggers.action: Re-run the plan/necro PoBs; if DPS or EHP drops >20%, re-evaluate 1A vs 1B.

triggers.condition: day >= 3 AND a pivot build is a top-5 skill/ascendancy in HC SSF
triggers.action: Check its top characters' gear for SSF reachability; raise its char #2 priority if reachable.
triggers.source: poe.ninja (Covens HC SSF URL TBD at launch)

triggers.condition: community report (Reddit/X/YouTube) confirmed by 2+ sources
triggers.action: Deadly: add to the Fate blacklist. OP Viscera from a specific map boss: add a target-farm map once G03 is met.

triggers.condition: PathOfBuilding dev branch has_3_30_data == true
triggers.action: Re-run your PoBs on the 3.30 data and update the gate numbers.
triggers.source: headless Path of Building run (field pob.has_3_30_data)

triggers.item: Smuggler's Cache maps / Whakano level gate
triggers.condition: identified on poedb or in game
triggers.action: Add the cache maps to the Heist rotation; confirm the level-68 meaning.

triggers.condition: A3 done / A10 staff+skill point taken / A10 Kitava dead
triggers.action: Normal lab after A3 (Mistress of Sacrifice → Bone Offering on you); Cruel right before A10 Kitava (Commander of Darkness); Merciless right after Kitava (Mindless Aggression; skip if tired). Uber: Bone Barrier.

triggers.condition: arrive at Stop 1 (A2), 2 (A3 lvl 28), 3 (A6), 4 (post A10 Kitava)
triggers.action: Do only that stop's list (launch_plan.md §1.3); ≤ 4 min (6h) / ≤ 12 min (7h). Stop 1 minion wand (Fear essence), Stop 2 Raise Spectre + first spectres.

triggers.condition: Atlas opened
triggers.action: Betrayal (Shaped Region first).

triggers.condition: second map-device slot unlocked
triggers.action: Expedition. Gwennen = 'take a chance' coin-flip craft on your rares (no gambling).

triggers.condition: not overpowered (below G04 or not comfortable in 3-Fate reds)
triggers.action: Do not run Ultimatum.

triggers.condition: no Cane / AWoRA / Sword of Ages in hand
triggers.action: Start Spectre Necromancer (1A): Absolution bridge, SRS support A1-A4, Frostbearers from Verisium in maps.
triggers.source: starter_head_to_head.md §Necro vs Occultist; your Nov 12 old-character test

triggers.condition: day 1-2 reports (2+ sources) AND you want early Fate-stacking
triggers.action: Switch the main/next char to Storm Burst Hierophant (totems keep ~100% uptime while moving; ED's Blight part is channelled).

triggers.condition: char.build=='ED Occultist' AND no Cane AND tier_band>=T8 AND 1-2 Fate yellow bosses feel slow
triggers.action: Roll Storm Burst Hierophant (your own L98 had no uniques: 5.0M full / 51k EHP).

triggers.condition: PoB has 3.30 data OR a hotfix touches Raise Spectre/Absolution/ED/Contagion
triggers.action: Re-run Necro + Occultist PoBs and update the recommendation.

triggers.condition: you ask, or mines get a 3.30 re-arm fix
triggers.action: Low priority; 66.9k EHP in Goratha's PoB is below the 115k bar, and it has visual clutter. No 3.30 change to mine detonation/re-arm found.

triggers.condition: char.build=='Spectre Necromancer' AND tier_band>=T11 AND frostbearers==0
triggers.action: Don't stall. You only need one cold Verisium wave (Desecrate copies it), so keep running ore. Meanwhile: Wretched Defilers (map-boss spectre: Sanctuary/Ziggurat/Abomination/Fortress/Citadel per poedb; Atlas presence unverified) or stay on Absolution to red maps (Travic 3.30). Take Fortune's Favour + Yield Upon Yield (+8 atlas points).

triggers.condition: end of Saturday session OR entering a new tier band
triggers.action: Count Frostbearers, effective Raise Spectre level, spectre cap; swap only with 3+ (Ghazzy/Travic/JayOE all say don't go full spectre with fewer).

triggers.item: Ore atlas path: Prospector's Luck → Verisium Infusion
triggers.condition: Atlas opened AND frostbearers < spectre cap
triggers.action: First 4 atlas points: Prospector's Luck (+36% ore chance). Next 13: Verisium Infusion (+100% chance for deposits to be Verisium, plus 5 Map Drop Chance nodes = sustain), 17 points total. Then Essence (+5), Harvest/Call of the Grove (+5), Sinistral Threads = Betrayal (+8), Dextral Threads = Expedition (+3), 38 total. Don't refund the ore path; it's mostly map drop chance.

triggers.condition: Necro and Occultist both failing (deaths, damage or defense) OR you just want low effort
triggers.action: Boneshatter Juggernaut fallback (no uniques, Ziz 3.30 PoB). Fallback only: you're burned out on it.
